title: 第13章 有人找你第14章 我要请假
lines: 第13章有人找你
“对了，大腿……”方思思还想说些什么。
“你能不叫大腿吗？”乔桑直接打断了她。
“那要不我叫你美腿？”方思思问道。
在乔桑的死亡凝视下方思思终于改了口，“乔桑，你是不是已经契约宠兽了？”
任何刚觉醒的御兽师都抵抗不了第一时间去契约宠兽的诱惑。
乔桑点点头没有否认。
方思思刚想接着问，班级里的声音却突然像被按了静音。
抬头看，原来是老班来了……
下一秒，方思思脸色刷白。
惨了惨了，她作业还没有抄好！
“五分钟后我们操场集合。”老班说完这句话往乔桑的方向看了一眼。
文成初中4000多名学生，300多名在职教师全部聚集在操场上，乌压压的一片。
“怎么全校都来了？”站在后面的方思思用手指戳了戳乔桑。
“不知道。”乔桑道。
初三处于冲刺阶段基本不会跟初一，初二的学生一起搞晨会，哪怕学校要求集合，也总有那么一两个班是例外。
乔桑抬头看了看主席台，发现包括校长，副校长，教导主任在内，所有学校的高层全都到齐，这可是往常晨会不可多见的大场面。
校长陈勇锋在台上讲着陈年旧词，每次晨会发言说来说去就那么几句，没个新意。
乔桑百无聊赖，台上讲什么都没有听进去。
十几分钟后，耳边响起了轰鸣般的掌声，乔桑下意识地跟着一起鼓掌。
一道娇小的身影从初三部走到了主席台上。
“尊敬的老师，亲爱的同学们，大家好，我是初三九班的戴淑淑，很荣幸……”
原以为只是个普通的晨会，没想到是戴淑淑个人的表彰大会。
戴淑淑这个人乔桑没有打过交道，但旁边的人议论的多了，总也知道个一二。
她家境不好，是唯一一个领着学校助学金的人，初中三年都是年级第一，后来自主觉醒被保送到御兽高中，典型的励志代表。
“被保送了又有什么用，就她家那样，买得起宠兽吗？”右边站着的男生讽刺道。
“她爸妈都不是御兽师，也不知道怎么生出个自主觉醒的御兽师来。”有人议论道。
乔桑有些意外，随着御兽社会的发展，人类早就意识到御兽师跟御兽师结合生出的孩子是御兽师的可能性更大。
越是等级高的御兽师越容易生出天赋高的孩子。
相反，两个都是普通人那么他们的孩子能成为御兽师的几率只有2%。
要说普通人生的孩子出现御兽师还有那么点几率，那出现自主觉醒的人概率真的是几乎小到没有。
乔桑起了兴致，竖耳听起了发言。
“这次被保送到圣水中学除了自身的努力还离不开老师……”
乔桑睫毛一抖。
她们都是自主觉醒，现在有个圣水中学搁在里面，很难让乔桑不拿自己跟她比较一下。
这一比，心塞了，听接下来的发言又是意兴阑珊。
回到教室，乔桑就一门心思放在书上。

Chapter 13 Someone is looking for you
"By the way, thighs..." Fang Sisi wanted to say something else.
"Can you not call me Thigh?" Qiao Sang interrupted her directly.
"How about I call you Beautiful Legs?" Fang Sisi asked.
Qiao Sang: "..."
Under Qiao Sang's death gaze, Sisi finally changed her words, "Qiao Sang, have you contracted a pet animal?"
Any newly awakened beast master cannot resist the temptation to contract a pet beast immediately.
Qiao Sang nodded and did not deny it.
"Then you..."
Just as Fang Sisi was about to ask further, the voices in the class suddenly seemed to have been muted.
Looking up, it turns out that Laoban is here...
The next second, Fang Sisi's face turned pale.
What a misfortune, she hasn't finished copying her homework yet!
"We will meet at the playground in five minutes." After saying this, Laoban glanced in Qiao Sang's direction.
More than 4,000 students and more than 300 in-service teachers from Wencheng Junior High School gathered on the playground in a huddle.
"Why is the whole school here?" Fang Sisi, who was standing behind, poked Qiao Sang with her finger.
"I don't know." Qiao Sang said.
Those in the third grade of junior high school who are in the sprint stage will basically not hold morning meetings with the students in the first and second grades of junior high school. Even if the school requires gatherings, there are always one or two classes that are exceptions.
Qiao Sang looked up at the rostrum and found that all the school's senior officials, including the principal, vice principal, and dean of students, were present. This was a rare occasion for morning meetings.
Principal Chen Yongfeng talks about old words on the stage. Every time he speaks in the morning meeting, he only repeats a few words without any new ideas.
Qiao Sang was bored and didn't listen to anything said on stage.
Ten minutes later, roaring applause rang in his ears, and Qiao Sang subconsciously clapped along with him.
A petite figure walked from the third grade junior high school to the podium.
"Dear teacher, dear classmates, hello everyone, I am Dai Shushu from Class 9, Grade 3. I am honored..."
I thought it was just an ordinary morning meeting, but I didn't expect it to be Dai Shushu's personal commendation meeting.
Qiao Sang has never dealt with Dai Shushu, but the people around her have talked about it a lot, so they know a thing or two about her.
She came from a poor family and was the only one to receive a school scholarship. She was the first in her grade for three years in junior high school. Later, she awakened on her own and was recommended to Yushou High School. She is a typical inspirational representative.
"What's the use of being recommended? Can someone like her family afford a pet?" the boy standing on the right said sarcastically.
"Her parents are not beast masters, and they don't know how to give birth to a beast master who awakens independently." Someone commented.
Qiao Sang was a little surprised. With the development of beast-control society, humans have long realized that the child born from the union of a beast-master and a beast-master is more likely to be a beast-master.
The higher the level of a beast master, the easier it is for him to give birth to a child with high talent.
On the contrary, if both of them are ordinary people, the chance of their child becoming a beast master is only 2%.
If there is still a small chance for an ordinary child to become a beastmaster, then the chance for someone to awaken on their own is really almost non-existent.
Qiao Sang became interested and listened to the speech.
"Being recommended to Shengshui Middle School this time is not only due to my own efforts, but also because of my teachers..."
Qiao Sang fluttered her eyelashes.
They all awakened independently, and now that there is Shengshui Middle School in it, it is difficult for Qiao Sang not to compare herself with her.
After this comparison, my heart was filled with frustration, and my interest in listening to the next speech was waning.
Back in the classroom, Qiao Sang concentrated on his books.
